sahil: quick FYI — bringing up orion-lite-7b (community ckpt) on int4 shows weird behavior: snippets fine, but multi-turn chat with long history gets garbled and embeddings diverge.

eval-bot: job/5109876543 finished: task=chat-longctx, metric=embed_cosine, float=0.905, int4=0.686, delta=-0.219 :warning:

rita: did converter preserve head/proj layout? some fan ckpts use odd proj ordering (qkv layout swapped) and our loader flattens it.

sasha: also check rotary metadata — orion-lite ckpt includes a 2D per-head matrix of scales (weird) instead of simple vector. runtime expects scalar. could be causing phase mismatch after quantization.

sahil: converter command: `python tools/convert.py --src orion-lite/ckpt --dst redwood/orion-lite-rlib --quant int4 --manifest`
converter log: `rotary_meta: mode=per_head_matrix shape=(num_heads,2)`

zoe: tokenizer note: ckpt tokenizer keeps soft-hyphen and some ZWJ combos; our normalizer strips them. token diffs ~0.8%.

rita: plan to bisect: (1) float with ckpt tokenizer; (2) int4 with proj-order remap; (3) int4 with rotary-matrix -> collapse to per-head scalar (e.g., mean) before apply; (4) test kernels fast vs stable; (5) kv-cache write vs read rescale.

sasha: quick smoke results pasted:
- float + ckpt-tokenizer => embed=0.902
- int4 + proj-remap => embed=0.744
- int4 + proj-remap + rotary-collapse(mean) => embed=0.781
- int4 + proj-remap + rotary-collapse + stable-kernel => embed=0.798

eval-bot: logs at infra/onnboard/orion-lite/5109876543, artifacts uploaded.

sahil: interesting: proj-order alone costs ~0.16. rotary-matrix collapse helps ~0.04-0.05. kernel ~0.02. tokenizer only explains ~0.003. so majority is layout/rotation handling.

zoe: for rotary-matrix we tried two heuristics: mean across the 2-dim entries, and principal-component projection to one scalar per head. mean slightly better for this model.

sasha: action items:
- converter: detect rotary_meta with unexpected shapes and emit onboarding lint + auto-collapse option with chosen heuristic (--rotary-collapse=mean|pca).
- loader/runtime: add proj-order detection and optional remap shim with warning; prefer not to do silent remapping.
- infra: add stable-warmup mode (first 64 tokens use stable quant kernel) to reduce cold-cache rounding errors.
- devex: add docs note about tokenizer normalization differences (soft-hyphen/ZWJ) and recommended converter flag `--tokenizer=ckpt` to preserve behavior during onboarding.

sahil: i'll open RI-77821 with failures, repro snippet, and top 5 failing example pairs. starting a full eval run with rotary-collapse=mean + proj-remap + stable-warmup.

eval-bot: job/5109876605 started: orion-lite-int4-full-eval (config=proj-remap,rotary-collapse=mean,stable-warmup=64)

sasha: if full eval recovers >0.88 we can merge conversion lint + runtime shims and recommend converter flags. if not, fallback plan: keep stable-kernel-only for longctx for this model class.

rita: thanks — keeping thread as single-source for onboarding notes. will post results here. :thumbsup:
